evidence: A reading of products: the design routing's receivers and flows followed upstream from each mouth along the donor carrying the most water, with the sustained-rivers study's lowest-year flows, the falls and the districts draft read along each course. Flows are the design climate's means on its closed budget; the climate is an estimate.
reading_rule: One entry per waterway carrying mouth_m3s or more where it ends, largest first; a tributary is listed apart from the waterway it joins, from the join upstream. Lengths in km along the 1.9 km cells' centres; lake_km is the length through lakes and channel_km the rest. flow_* in m3/s; lowest_year_m3s is the sustained discharge at the channel nearest the mouth; falters_km the length of channel that carries under the sustained-rivers threshold in some year. fed_by is headwaters, a full sea's overflow, the near-side sea's spill over its neck, or a branch the works cut (works marks those); regions gives each region's share of the course's cells. course lists latitude and longitude in the settled frame from the mouth upstream.
